summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing of the Pharma Commercial Analytics platform. 35/35 pytest tests passed (100% success), covering all 12 routers and 3 AI/LLM-backed endpoints (briefing/generate, chat/ask, exec/narrative) via the Emergent LLM provider. Data totals validated: 50 HCPs, 18 reps, 200 interactions, 34 conversions, 17.0% conversion rate vs 12% target (+5 uplift), 14 source tables loaded, 6 suggested chat questions, 8-week forecast points. LLM calls completed end-to-end in ~25-30s each.
critical_code_review_comments: Conversion audit endpoint returns null attribution_link for non-converted interactions (e.g., INT00117). Consider adding an explicit attribution_link='none' or empty-state field rather than null for clarity in the audit UI.
HCP opportunity endpoint returns 'opportunity_score' while internal scoring uses 'score' terminology elsewhere — consider standardizing field naming across endpoints (opportunity_score vs score).

Some list endpoints return a wrapper {total, items} while others return a bare list (e.g., conversion/trend, chat/suggested, nba/ranked). Standardizing response envelopes (always {items, total} or always bare array) would simplify client consumption.
row_counts table name 'field_interactions_source' is verbose — could expose a friendly alias like 'interactions' alongside for API consumers.
test_credentials: Not required — Open demo mode with role switcher; no auth on backend endpoints
seed_data_creation: None — all tests use in-memory pandas DataStore seeded by lifespan: 50 HCPs, 18 reps, 200 interactions, 34 conversions, 18 KOLs, 12 accounts, 10 products, 14 source tables
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at https://52fc47d2-22c3-4873-8e08-8e873065f130.preview.emergentagent.com/api fully validated. All 12 routers and AI endpoints functional via Emergent LLM provider (provider field returns in briefing/generate response). LLM endpoints take 20-30s; use timeout >=90s. Frontend testing has not been performed yet — next iteration should cover React/MUI UI flows, role switcher, chart rendering with Recharts, and integration with these confirmed-working APIs. Test file located at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all endpoints listed in the original review request.
rca of the issue: No backend bugs found. The 3 initial test failures were test-script assertion mismatches (wrong field names: 'interactions' vs 'field_interactions_source', 'score' vs 'opportunity_score', and operator precedence on items extraction). Fixed in test file; all 35 tests now pass.
